name: SikaQuick-2500 AU
paste:
SIKAQUICK®-2500 AU: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaQuick®-2500 AU, November 2025, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikaquick-2500-au.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaQuick®-2500 AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaQuick®-2500 AU is a 1- part, cementitious, very rapid hardening, early strength gain concrete repair material.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - On, above and below grade on concrete
    - Highway overlays and repairs
    - Structural repair material for concrete roadways, parking structures, bridges, dams and ramps
    - Full depth patching repairs
    - Economical patching material for horizontal repairs of concrete and mortar
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaQuick®-2500 AU
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: RAPID HARDENING, HIGH STRENGTH TRAFFICABLE REPAIR MORTAR
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Approved by Qld TMR - Product Index for Bridges and Other Structure. Complies with the requirements of MRTS274.
    - Meets RTA Rapid Mortar Bar Test RTA T363 <0.1% Non-Reactive
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS 1478.2:2005: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C 348: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - AS 2350.13-2006: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shrinkage (p.2).
    - EN 1542: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile adhesion strength (p.2).
    - AS/NZS 2350.4-2006: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Final set time (p.2); Application Information > Initial set time (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very rapid hardening as defined by ASTM C-928
    - Epoxy coatings can be applied as early as 4 hours
    - Freeze / thaw resistant
    - Easy to mix and apply - labor saving
    - High early strength
    - Fast setting
    - Open to foot traffic in 45 minutes
    - Open to vehicle traffic in 1 hour (at 23 °C)
    - Not a vapour barrier
    - Can be placed up to 150mm
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Cement, selected aggregates and special additives
    - Appearance and colour: Grey powder
    - Fresh mortar density: 2,200 kg/m3
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Shrinkage: ~500 με after 28 days at 23 °C / 50 % r.h. (AS 2350.13-2006)
    - Tensile adhesion strength: ≥ 2.0MPa (EN 1542)
2.7 Compressive strength.
    | Time | Compressive Strength |
    | 1 hour | ~ 13 MPa |
    | 2 hour | ~ 20 MPa |
    | 1 day | ~ 35 MPa |
    | 7 days | ~ 65 MPa |
    | 28 days | 80 MPa |
    | Material and curing conditions at (23°C / 50% r.h.) Water/powder = 0.105 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (AS 1478.2:2005)
2.8 Tensile strength.
    | Time | Tensile strength in Flexure |
    | 1 day | > 5.5 MPa |
    | 7 days | > 6.9 MPa |
    | 28 days | > 7.6 MPa |
    | Material and curing conditions at (23 °C / 50% r.h.) Water/powder = 0.105 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (ASTM C 348)
2.9 Electrical resistivity.
    | 7 days | ~ 52,000 Ω.cm |
    | 28 days | ~ 114,000 Ω.cm |
    | 56 days | ~ 126,000 Ω.cm |
    | 90 days | ~ 175,000 Ω.cm |
    Test method printed: (FM5-578)
    Test method printed: 50mm Probe Spa-
    Test method printed: cing
2.10 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20 kg bag
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 4°C - 35°C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - Concrete
    - Surface must be clean and sound. Remove all deteriorated concrete, dirt, oil, grease, and other bond-inhibiting materials from the area to be repaired. Be sure repair area is not less than 5 mm deep. Preparation work should be done by appropriate mechanical techniques.
    - Obtain an exposed aggregate surface with a minimum surface profile of 3 mm (CSP 6) on clean, sound concrete. To ensure optimum repair results, the effectiveness of decontamination and preparation should be assessed by a pull-off test. Saw cutting of edges is recommended. Saturate surface to be repaired with clean water. Substrate should be saturated surface dry (SSD) prior to application.
    - Steel reinforcement
    - Rust, scale, mortar, concrete, dust and other loose and deleterious material which reduces bond or contributes to corrosion shall be removed. Surfaces shall be prepared using abrasive blast cleaning techniques or high pressure water-blasting to achieve a bright metal finish.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 2.1 – 2.4 litres of water per 20 kg bag
    - Yield: 10 litres per 20 kg bag
    - Pot Life: Approximately 15 minutes after adding powder to the water
    - Initial set time: ~ 15 - 20 minutes at 23 °C / 50 % r.h. (AS/NZS 2350.4-2006)
    - Final set time: ~ 25 - 30 minutes at 23 °C / 50 % r.h. (AS/NZS 2350.4-2006)
4.3 Mixing. Mechanically mix in an appropriately sized mortar mixer. Wet down all tools and mixer to be used. Start with 2.1 litres of water added to the mixing vessel. Add 1 bag of SikaQuick®-2500 AU while continuing to mix. Add up to another 0.3 litres of water to achieve desired consistency. Do not over water.
4.4 Application. Reinforcement Corrosion Protection / Primer Coating Where a reinforcement coating is required, apply to the whole exposed circumference of the steel the SikaTop-110 EpoCem or Sika Monotop-910N. The repair mortar must be applied into the coating ‘wet’ on ‘dry’.
4.5 Application - Concrete Bonding Primer. Prime the prepared substrate with a scrub coat of SikaQuick®-2500 AU by firmly scraping the scrub coat over the substrate surface to form a thin layer and fill any pores or cavities in the surface. Ensure the whole surface to be repaired is covered by the scrub coat. The repair mortar has to be applied into primer ‘wet’ on ‘wet’.
4.6 Application - Repair Mortar. The prepared mortar must be scrubbed into the substrate. Be sure to fill all pores and voids. force materials against the edge of the repair, working towards the centre. After filling the repair, screed of excess. Allow concrete to set to desired stiffness, then finish. If a smoother finish is desired, a magnesium float should be used. Mixing, placing and finishing should not exceed 15 minutes maximum. To control setting times, cold water should be used in hot weather and hot water used in cold weather.
4.7 Curing treatment. Moist cure should commence immediately after finishing. It is necessary to protect newly applied material from rain. To prevent from freezing, cover with insulating material.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be mechanically removed.
4.9 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Apply only to sound, prepared substrate.
    - Avoid application in direct sun and/or strong winds.
    - Do not feather edge.
    - Use only potable water.
    - Variations in aggregates may produce differences in strengths from the typical values stated in Product Data Sheet.
    - For early application of epoxy coatings. On site testing is recommended for verification. Consult coatings manufacturer for advice.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. 7°C minimum
5.3 Substrate temperature. 7°C minimum
5.4 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Obtain an exposed aggregate surface with a minimum surface profile of 3 mm (CSP 6) on clean, sound concrete. To ensure optimum repair results, the effectiveness of decontamination and preparation should be assessed by a pull-off test. Saw cutting of edges is recommended. Saturate surface to be repaired with clean water. Substrate should be saturated surface dry (SSD) prior to application.
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: Time | Compressive Strength; 1 hour | ~ 13 MPa; 2 hour | ~ 20 MPa; 1 day | ~ 35 MPa; 7 days | ~ 65 MPa; 28 days | 80 MPa; Material and curing conditions at (23°C / 50% r.h.) Water/powder = 0.105 (AS 1478.2:2005)
    - Tensile strength: Time | Tensile strength in Flexure; 1 day | > 5.5 MPa; 7 days | > 6.9 MPa; 28 days | > 7.6 MPa; Material and curing conditions at (23 °C / 50% r.h.) Water/powder = 0.105 (ASTM C 348)
    - Shrinkage: ~500 με after 28 days at 23 °C / 50 % r.h. (AS 2350.13-2006)
    - Tensile adhesion strength: ≥ 2.0MPa (EN 1542)
    - Electrical resistivity: 7 days | ~ 52,000 Ω.cm; 28 days | ~ 114,000 Ω.cm; 56 days | ~ 126,000 Ω.cm; 90 days | ~ 175,000 Ω.cm (FM5-578) 50mm Probe Spa- cing
    - Initial set time: ~ 15 - 20 minutes at 23 °C / 50 % r.h. (AS/NZS 2350.4-2006)
    - Final set time: ~ 25 - 30 minutes at 23 °C / 50 % r.h. (AS/NZS 2350.4-2006)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaQuick®-2500 AU, November 2025, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikaquick-2500-au.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaQuick®-2500 AU, version 25/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sds-sikaquick-2500au.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: MSDS SikaQuick® 2500 AU GHS7, https://aus.sika.com/dms/getdocument.get/e5ebec69-6738-4ca9-8acf-16ffff2ce525/MSDS%20SikaQuick%C2%AE%202500%20AU%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
